label: Only on AGSIST
note: Computed by code from the elevator boards AGSIST reads. Not written by the drafting model.

facts.sentence: On Tuesday, Nov 3, 1,748 of the 1,783 elevators AGSIST reads with the same delivery month both days posted a lower cash corn bid than Monday, 30 a higher one; 217 changed their basis, 11 weaker and 206 stronger.
facts.detail: 5 unchanged; median change 8¢ lower. Biggest state move: Iowa, 8¢ lower (385 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.comparison: last posted bid on 2026-11-03 vs 2026-11-02, same board, crop and delivery period
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)

facts.sentence: Corn basis on Nov 4 ran from 55¢ over December futures in Texas to 90¢ under in North Dakota, state medians of the elevators AGSIST read at 5:27 a.m. CT.
facts.detail: Median of 17 elevators in Texas, 47 in North Dakota. 15 states with 15 or more. USDA's North Dakota average on Nov 3: 89 under Dec (USDA AMS, North Dakota Daily Grain Bids, Nov 3, 2026).
facts.unit: cents per bushel between the strongest and weakest state median
facts.comparison: state median basis against ZCZ26, states with 15+ elevators
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, state median basis (scripts/basis_method.py, data/basis-states.json)

facts.sentence: Of 1,797 elevators AGSIST reads with a fresh corn bid on Nov 4, 156 were paying over futures, most of them in Kansas (34).
